description:
## Goal

Make the boxed apply seam's return convention coherent when a construction-wrapper member returns a capture-free function reference or lambda and that same member already has a non-bottom, callable-only return demand. The wrapper and every boxed caller must agree on one public return word.

## Current state (re-described 2026-09-15 at main f26264572 plus PR #169)

RuntimeDemand::is_ignore() is true only when both the shape axis is ignored and the callable axis is empty, so the seam bootstrap in settle_demand_cone raises only bottom contributions. A member whose joined return contribution is shape=Ignore plus a non-empty exact callable axis is not bootstrapped even behind a construction wrapper; a capture-free exact callable reserves zero private ABI lanes, so the member can publish an Absent return (BackendCallableReturn::Absent) while a boxed callsite reads the seam's one ValueRef word.

The verifier is now BoxedContracts::validate (src/compiler2/backend_program/boxed_contract.rs): after #169 it compares return REPRS (BackendCallableReturn::return_reprs) rather than lane counts, includes tail callers, and fails the root with artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan. It is the one remaining backstop in this area and stays until this ticket makes the state unreachable.

## Fix shape

Collapse BackendCallableReturn::Absent into ValueRef: every wrapper returns one public word and every boxed caller reads one. Then delivered == published by construction, and boxed_contract.rs (~550 lines), boxed_contract_test.rs, and its five call sites are deleted in the same motion; the residual Absent paragraph in .agent/docs/pipeline.md goes with them. Exact direct-only callable returns stay zero-lane (they never cross the seam).

## Acceptance

- Minimal fnref and lambda witnesses (capture-free callable returned by a member that is also a wrapper member) produce the expected value through interp, JIT, and AOT.
- Capturing callable-return, boxed-only, different-activation, and destination-passing controls do not regress.
- BoxedContracts and its tests are deleted; no verifier replaces them.
- Behavior fixture(s) plus a focused demand/transport contract test; pipeline.md updated; full gate green.
title: A boxed-seam member with a callable-only return contribution can publish zero lanes against a one-word caller
